title: Definitive CAMA/RAMA Meta-Analysis: 15 Experiments Across Iterations 2-5
summary: Demo notebook for the Definitive CAMA/RAMA Meta-Analysis across 15 experiments (iterations 2-5). Demonstrates the 6-phase analysis pipeline: GRADE-adapted evidence grading, per-task best-evidence selection, DerSimonian-Laird random-effects meta-analysis under 4 scenarios, sum-comparison sub-analysis, critical diagnostics (gate stasis, degenerate baselines), and publication readiness assessment. Uses 22 pre-extracted effect sizes loaded from mini_demo_data.json. Includes forest plot and pooled effect size visualizations. Note: install cell needs scipy version fix for Python 3.10 environments (scipy==1.15.3 instead of 1.16.3).
